carmen: Quick question — we're slotting the interactive workshop (60m) with 3 simultaneous breakouts. Need a plan for attendee->breakout routing and Zoom room ownership. Who's on this? :thinking_face:
noah: I can own routing logic (HubSpot -> Zoom), but need the track definitions and speaker pairings first.
rita: Track defs: Beginner prompts, Cost & infra best practices, Observability + alerts. Each track needs 1 lead + 1 floater.
kevin: Floater from Eng can cover demo hiccups. I'll take infra track lead.
sophia: For APAC attendees we should prioritize timezone-aware slotting and separate breakout for localization questions.
carmen: Perfect. For routing, let's use a short pre-event survey with a hidden field `workshop_track` and HubSpot list memberships. Ops-bot, can you confirm we can create 3 Zoom breakout rooms and preassign via API?
ops-bot: zoom-provisioner: confirmed — 3 breakout rooms can be pre-created and pre-assigned using registration mapping. Rate limit note: preassign requires matching Zoom emails with registration.
noah: Routing pseudo-workflow:
```
1) Registration form -> hidden `track_choice` (begins/infra/obs)
2) HubSpot workflow: tag contact with `track_choice`
3) Export list -> Zoom preassign (email match)
4) Live fallback: in-room moderator drops attendees into rooms via host controls
```
Will implement w/ webhook to avoid manual CSV.
rita: Run-of-show sketch for the 60m workshop:
- 00:00–05:00 host welcome + context + housekeeping
- 05:00–25:00 2x 10m micro-demos per track (recorded demos + Qs)
- 25:00–50:00 breakouts (20 min breakout + 5 min regroup)
- 50:00–60:00 cross-track highlights + CTA (signup for Dedicated trial)
kevin: Rehearsal plan: full tech run w/ speakers + 1 floater + host. Need to schedule 30–45 min dry run 48h before. Can we lock rehearsal times now?
sophia: Suggest two rehearsal slots to cover APAC/EU availability: Tue 8am PT and Thu 4pm PT. Which works for speakers?
carmen: I'll ping speakers. Rita — can you produce speaker cue-cards and a one-page FAQ for moderators? Keep CTAs and switch-to-host script.
rita: On it. Draft will live here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/workshops/interactive-slotting (will post when ready).
noah: One more inbound-lead note: set HubSpot property `event_engagement` to track who joined breakout vs left early. We can fire event: `joined_breakout: {track}` via frontend.
kevin: For demo fallbacks, prepare a low-bandwidth recording URL and a local laptop handoff script: `if stream fails -> share link -> continue Qs`.
carmen: Awesome — next steps: (1) Rita drafts track scripts + cue-cards by EOD Thu, (2) Noah wires HubSpot workflow by Mon, (3) Kevin & Ops schedule rehearsal times and confirm Zoom preassign, (4) Sophia confirms APAC messaging and CTA variants. I'll update the run sheet after we have speaker confirmations. :raised_hands:
